Application Data.NAME: Visionary Optical Services, LLC
Application Data.MAILING ADDRESS: 1234 Visionary Way, Suite 100, New York, NY 10001-2345
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Visionary Optical Services, LLC specializes in the retail sale of high-quality optical frames, lenses, and accessories. We offer in-house laboratory services, including lens edging and minor frame repairs, ensuring adherence to industry safety standards and quality controls. Our knowledgeable staff is trained in customer service and prescription accuracy, and we maintain a well-organized inventory and security system to prevent loss. We also implement a documented customer recall program for prescription updates to ensure patient safety and satisfaction.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, a minor water leak occurred in the in-house laboratory due to a malfunctioning sink, resulting in $2,000.00 in damages for repairs and cleanup. The issue was promptly resolved, and no customer prescriptions were affected. The status of the loss is closed and fully resolved.
